title: Executive Assistant - Work from Home
tools_required: linkedin; crm; excel; word; data entry; admin
why_it_fits: Executive Assistant match. 6 skills: linkedin, crm, excel, word, data entry. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
The Executive Assistant will provide executive, administrative, and sales administration support to the Sales Director and senior managers. This role will support CRM management, client communications, quotes, proposals, tender follow-up, board reporting, email and calendar management, document control, reporting, travel, events, and process documentation to help keep sales activity and business operations organised and moving efficiently.
- Support the Sales Director and senior managers with day-to-day executive, administrative, and sales support requirements.
- Prepare client proposals, quotations, and supporting documents ready for final review.
- Set up, update, and manage client deals, opportunities, and records within the CRM database.
- Support account management activity by following up client communications, tracking responses, and helping ensure deals remain on track.
- Act as client support by responding to client correspondence on behalf of managers where required.
- Manage email correspondence, including tagging, sorting, filing, and organising communications for manager review and action.
- Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, demos, and schedules to ensure manager time is well organised and accounted for.
- Provide personal assistant support where required, including email, calendar, travel, scheduling, and general coordination tasks.
- Schedule appointments, meetings, and demos for the sales team with qualified leads, ensuring all activity is documented in the CRM.
- Assist with document management, formatting, version control, and preparation of professional business documents.
- Conduct online research, data collection, LinkedIn research, and lead searching to support sales and business development activity.
- Assist with tender follow-up, sourcing new contacts, and supporting opportunities outside existing business channels.
- Prepare weekly and monthly reports, including sales, activity, board, and operational reporting where required.
- Assist with board report preparation by gathering information from relevant stakeholders and preparing supporting documentation.
- Support the preparation and documentation of internal company policies, procedures, systems, maintenance manuals, and process documents.
- Use automation tools and integrations to streamline administrative and sales support processes where applicable.
- Coordinate travel bookings, event attendance planning, event staff bookings, and entertainment organisation where required.
- Maintain high professional standards, support team culture, and uphold company values in all internal and external communication.
- Other position-level duties as they arise.
- Minimum 4+ years' experience in executive assistance, sales administration, business administration, client support, or a similar administrative support role.
- Experience supporting senior leaders, directors, managers, or sales teams in a fast-paced business environment.
- Experience with CRM software, including maintaining client records, updating deals, tracking communications, and documenting sales activity.
- Strong experience preparing proposals, quotations, reports, business documents, and client-facing correspondence.
- Experience in sales administration, appointment setting, client follow-up, tender support, or account management support is highly regarded.
- Strong email and calendar management skills, with the ability to organise priorities, meetings, correspondence, and follow-up actions.
- Intermediate Microsoft Word and Excel skills, with strong document formatting, reporting, data entry, and spreadsheet capability.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence dealing with customers, managers, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
- Experience handling incoming and outgoing phone calls professionally is highly regarded.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder requests.
- High attention to detail across documents, CRM records, reports, communications, formatting, and follow-up activity.
- Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and keep tasks moving without close supervision.
- Proactive, reliable, process-driven, and comfortable supporting both executive administration and sales administration tasks.
- Experience using automation tools, integrations, or workflow improvements to streamline administration is advantageous.
- Professional, ethical, and able to maintain confidentiality when handling client, manager, and company information.
